title: The Cost Of Staying Comfortable | A Discipline Short Film
lines: Comfort is expensive. It just sends the bill later.
You pay for it with the life you didn't build.
So he chooses the hard thing, on purpose, every single day.
Discipline costs you now. Regret costs you forever.
Pick your pain. One of them has a reward.
Walk toward the discomfort. That's where the growth lives.
